title: Strict circuit containment from inclusion
statement: If every language in $\mathsf{P}$ is decidable by a polynomial-size Boolean circuit family with fan-in at most two, then $\mathsf{P}$ is a proper subset of the class of all such circuit-decidable languages.
hypotheses_covered: Every language in $\mathsf{P}$ belongs to the class of polynomial-size fan-in-two circuit-decidable languages
